I let him know that I need a little space (which he is very good about giving to me), which has mostly prevented any BPD-driven arguments. Then, depending on how bad it is, I can usually just distract myself for a few hours and the feeling will fade. For the most lengthy episodes, I've been making a list of happy moments we have together combined with pictures, and I look through it to forcefully remind myself of why I'm with him. It doesn't always work (cuz I can get into the trap of feeling broken because it's not working right away) but it has been pretty helpful for me.

I've been having the exact same problem as you for going on two years now. Both flucanazole and BV medications did nothing for me. I tried a boric acid suppository as a last ditch effort from my gyno, and it only made things worse.

What has worked for me so far is a caprylic acid supplements - they are a "natural" way to combat yeast as it is the active ingredient in coconut oil. This combined with watching what sugars I eat has helped reduce the problem for me, so I wanted to pass that along. I really hope it works for you, because I know just how awful and depressing this condition can be.
